name: Grammarly
summary: A writing assistant. It reads the text you type on most websites to suggest corrections, and can use AI to rewrite it.

howToTurnOff.windows: In Chrome or Edge, type chrome://extensions (or edge://extensions) in the address bar, then switch the extension off or select Remove. In Firefox, open the menu > Add-ons and themes.
howToTurnOff.mac: In Chrome, type chrome://extensions in the address bar, then switch the extension off or select Remove. In Safari, open Safari > Settings > Extensions.
